svt_mipi_dsi_device_callback Class Reference

Inheritance diagram for class svt_mipi_dsi_device_callback:

List of all members.

Detailed Description

Class that encapsulates MIPI DSI device driver callback. User code can extend this class, add implementations to one or more of the callback methods. The user's callback class is then instantiated in the testbench and registered with the driver of interest.

 svt_mipi_dsi_device_callback::device_xact_packet_out_port_cov
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_device device , svt_mipi_dsi_packet xact  ) 

This callback is called only when drop bit of pre_device_xact_packet_out_port callback is 0 and before broadcasting formed DSI packet. The purpose of this method is to verify received packet before broadcasting.

This method issues the device_xact_packet_out_port_cov callback.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_device_callback::post_lane_transaction_get
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_device device , int lane_id , svt_mipi_lane_transaction xact , ref bit drop  ) 

Callback is called after receiving lane transaction from D-PHY/PPI receiver. With this method, user can drop that received lane transaction using drop bit provided with this callback.

device - Reference to the svt_mipi_dsi_device driver that is issuing this callback. The user's callback implementation can use this to access the public data and/or methods of the driver.

lane_id - Numerical ID that identifies which input port was just accessed.

xact - Reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.

drop - A ref argument, which if sets by the user's callback implementation causes the driver to discard the transaction descriptor without further action.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_device_callback::pre_device_xact_packet_out_port
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_device device , svt_mipi_dsi_packet xact , ref bit drop  ) 

After forming packet transmitted from DSI Host, that packet is broadcasted using analysis port. Before broadcasting this packet, user can use this callback to drop the packet by setting the drop bit.

This method issues the pre_device_xact_packet_out_port callback.

Overriding implementations in extended classes must call the super version of this method.

device - Reference to the driver object issuing this callback.

xact - Reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.

drop - A ref argument, which if set by the user's callback implementation causes the driver to discard the transaction descriptor without further action.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_device_callback::pre_xmtr_response_lane_data
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_device device , svt_mipi_lane_transaction xact , ref bit drop  ) 

After forming response packet, DSI Device converts that packet into lane transaction and that lane transaction will be driven on to the D-PHY/PPI transmitter . This callback is used before driving that lane transaction onto the D-PHY/PPI transmitter. Using this callback user can drop the lane transaction by setting the drop bit.

Overriding implementations in extended classes must call the super version of this method.

device - Reference to the driver object issuing this callback.

xact - Reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.

drop - A ref argument, which if sets by the user's callback implementation causes the driver to discard the transaction descriptor without further action.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_device_callback::received_lane_transaction
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_device device , int lane_id , svt_mipi_lane_transaction xact  ) 

Callback is added before forming packet transmitted from DSI Host.This callback is used only when the drop bit of post_lane_transaction_get is 0 and then that lane transaction will be used to form the packet.

device - Reference to the svt_mipi_dsi_device driver that is issuing this callback. The user's callback implementation can use this to access the public data and/or methods of the driver.

lane_id - Numerical ID that identifies which input port was just accessed.

xact - Reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_device_callback::response_data_lane_transaction_put
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_device device , svt_mipi_lane_transaction trans  ) 

This callback is called before transaction is driven on to the D-PHYtransmitter. The purpose of this method is to verify the packet before driving it on to D-PHY interface.

Overriding implementations in extended classes must call the super version of this method.

device - Reference to the driver object issuing this callback.

trans - Reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.

  function void
 svt_mipi_dsi_device_callback::response_lane_transaction_cov
 (  svt_mipi_dsi_device device , svt_mipi_lane_transaction xact  ) 

If drop bit of pre_xmtr_response_lane_data is 0, then this callback has been called and after this callback lane transaction will be driven on to the D-PHY/PPI transmitter. The purpose of this method is to verify received packet before driving it on to D-PHY/PPI interface.

Overriding implementations in extended classes must call the super version of this method.

device - Reference to the driver object issuing this callback.

xact - Reference to the transaction descriptor object of interest.
